title: Department of Military Affairs Reviews Over 2.46 Lakh Files During Special Campaign 6
body_text:
The Special Campaign 6 of the Department of Military Affairs, Ministry of Defence is being implemented from October 02 - 31, 2026. The Campaign is focused on achieving clean workplaces and surroundings through general cleanliness drives, improved space management, disposal of scrap, weeding out of records and beautification of available spaces.
During the first two weeks of the Campaign, over 2.46 lakh files have been reviewed, cleanliness drives have been undertaken at 3,553 campaign sites, and 158 rules have been reviewed and simplified. Revenue of ₹50.60 lakh has also been generated through the disposal of scrap so far.
The progress of the Campaign is being monitored on a daily basis to ensure the effective achievement of the targets set. With focus on the reduction of pendency in public grievances, references received from Members of Parliament, the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) and State Governments, the campaign is witnessing active participation of the defence forces and defence establishments across the country.
